department: PhD in Theory and Numerical Simulation of Condensed Matter

deadline.value: Spring call closes early March each year (exact date in the call); a second call in September only if places remain. 2027 call not yet published.
deadline.quote: The deadline for the Spring opening is early in March of every year (see details in the call for applications).

also.quote: Deadline for online submission of applications: 27th February, 2026

gre_subject.value: Not stated; selection is by SISSA's own written exam and interview

supervisor.value: Selection is a competition (qualifications, written exam, interview); no prior supervisor requirement mentioned
supervisor.quote: The students will be selected through a competition based on academic qualifications, a written exam and an interview held at SISSA (or via Skype/videoconference for candidates who can not reach Trieste).

funding.value: All admitted candidates receive a SISSA fellowship (EUR 1,120 net per month per the FAQ) for the whole course.
funding.quote: All admitted candidates will receive a fellowship of the amount of € 1.120,00 net per month.

also.quote: Ai candidati ammessi verrà attribuita una borsa di studio dell’importo di € | 16.242.96 annui al lordo delle trattenute INPS

entry_route.value: A Master's (or equivalent) degree is needed by the start of the course; a 4-year bachelor's is sometimes judged eligible by the Senate.
entry_route.quote: Yes you can, but you will have to obtain the Master degree (or equivalent) by the beginning of the courses.

also.quote: Usually a B.Sc. Hons. or a 4-year (or more) B.Sc. are sufficient.

notes: SISSA can contribute up to EUR 150 toward travel for the exams. Each SISSA physics group runs its own call and exam; this record covers Condensed Matter only.
